QuestInfo.name: [Esfera] Light and Darkness
QuestInfo.0: You find the traces of Tana that seemed to be deformed Erda. This could be a new clue. But you need to reduce the number of spiders before investigating the tombstone.
QuestInfo.1: There are still many of Will's spiders near the tombstone. Defeat around 200 #bAraneas#k and talk to Ollie.
QuestInfo.2: Tana's identity was a #bTranscendent in Waiting#k. Yet not everything has been disclosed yet. What is Will's purpose for wanting Tana? The keepers that manifested from Tana's will guide you and Ollie. Follow them.

default.0: It looks like there are still too many spiders.
